headline: Shein Reported €7.9 Billion in European Sales via Irish Entity in 2025
summary: New financial accounts reveal that Shein generated €7.9 billion in sales across Europe through its Irish subsidiary in 2025, prior to the introduction of new EU import charges.
why: The tax and revenue structures of large e-commerce platforms are under increasing scrutiny by EU regulators, impacting their operational costs and pricing strategies.
